turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Happy to! Let me show you how I think about one.
I work on Saturdays. My brother works on Saturdays.
First I ask: who is doing it? My brother, so "he".
Then I add -s to the verb: works.
Rule: when the person is he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: She works late. Wrong: She work late.

Your turn now. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
